'''Cinderclaw''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Silversear]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "People say that if you gaze into those eyes for too long, the dark thoughts hidden in the depths of your mind will ignite. Other Tatari keep their distance--which suits Cinderclaw just fine. Whenever the camp is in danger, however, the same terrifying flames are the first to engulf enemies."

Cinderclaw is a rainbow rarity Tatari.

==Strategy==
You should use [[Kittazap]]/evo alongside Cinderclaw because of the Paw Pals bond.
{{clear|left}}

== Trivia ==
* Cinderclaw was added to the game on 9/23/2026 alongside [[Dolphie]] and [[Thunderpaw]].
